speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You are well, she says, and you look it, which is not the same as a morning wasted. Sit. I have the jug in my hand, so the question will be short.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am well. I was still. That is the whole report.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I told her somebody was dead, sir, and then I told her it was not you. She did not like the order of it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I liked the ending. Eat. The Shrew is at two, and you are not in it, or you would have been gone already.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not in it. I am not going. There is a king on the board, and he is not finished, and I am not telling him at this table.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then do not tell him. I asked if you were alive. Mark me, that was the question. The plot can keep.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Is there a bit I could hear, sir? Only a line. Mistress says I am to go down, but a line is quick.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Not today. The sheets stay where they are. You would hear them wrong, and I would mind.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Leave him his sheets, Alse. If he will not eat the meat hot, I cannot promise it any patience. That is my last word, and it is about dinner.
